title: Army Warns Iowa of Toxic Cloud as It Prepares to Blow Up Old Ammo
summary: Friday’s explosion will dispose of unstable material used in detonators. A plume of dangerous lead dust could travel up to 60 miles, according to the latest Army estimate.
